$comment: The namespaces a bring-your-own chart may never target. ONE list, read by the runner (go:embed in byo.go) and mirrored by the console (apps/console/lib/validations/byo-reserved-namespaces.ts, deep-equal parity test). Every group is pinned to the thing it names by a test that fails in BOTH directions: kubernetes is fixed; platformTemplates equals the destinations rendered from infra/templates/argocd; platformRuntime equals the namespace constants the runner installs into; marketplaceAddOns equals the namespaces in the console's ADDON_CATALOG. Kept sorted.

groups.reason: it is a Kubernetes system namespace
the platform's own controllers (ArgoCD, cert-manager, External Secrets, ingress, DNS, autoscaling) install there
the platform runs its own components there
a platform-managed add-on from the marketplace installs there

prefixes.reason: Kubernetes reserves the kube- prefix for its system namespaces
the platform names every virtual cluster's host namespace vcluster-<name>
